variable_name: Rental price increase in non-rent-controlled locations
sheet_variable_name: Rental price increase in non–rent-controlled locations
why_hard_from_docx: Public rent indices do not flag rent-control status
best_public_workaround_from_docx: Use Zillow ZORI and exclude geographies by construction-year share (post-1995 / post-2005 proxy) or interact with policy exposure.
limitation: ZORI is loaded, but the sheet workaround also requires construction-year/rent-control exposure filters that are not implemented.

why_hard_from_docx: Clean completions data not consistently public at county level
best_public_workaround_from_docx: Proxy with lagged multifamily permits (5+) using completion lag structure; lags uncertain.
limitation: The sheet workaround is lagged multifamily permits with an explicit completion-lag structure; permits are loaded, but no completion proxy is calculated.

why_hard_from_docx: No public stock measure at county/state level
best_public_workaround_from_docx: Build pipeline stock: cumulative MF permits minus assumed completions over rolling window.
limitation: The sheet workaround is cumulative MF permits minus assumed completions over a rolling window; permit inputs are loaded, but the stock pipeline calculation is not implemented.

why_hard_from_docx: No public "build-for-rent" flag in Census data
best_public_workaround_from_docx: Proxy using SFR permits in high-investor / rental-growth tracts or small MF permits.
limitation: The sheet workaround needs SFR permits combined with investor/rental-growth tract logic; only 1-unit permits are loaded.

why_hard_from_docx: ACS is annual; no quarterly public alternative
best_public_workaround_from_docx: Annual ACS change in occupied renter units; optionally interpolate or use CPS/HVS for state-level timing.
limitation: ACS annual 5-year renter-occupied units are available; quarterly net change is not created.

why_hard_from_docx: Income is annual; prices are monthly
best_public_workaround_from_docx: Construct ratio using annual ACS income with interpolated or stepwise series.
limitation: Annual ACS ratio is implemented; quarterly/local alternatives are deferred.

why_hard_from_docx: Birth/death data is annual at county level
best_public_workaround_from_docx: Annual CDC WONDER series; interpolate if quarterly timing is needed.
limitation: Annual CDC WONDER births and deaths are loaded as observed annual county facts; annual natural population change is births minus deaths. The quarterly series evenly allocates the annual total to four quarters and is flagged as imputed/interpolated timing, not observed quarterly vital events.

best_public_workaround_from_docx: Annual HUD PIT; no credible quarterly public alternative.
limitation: The sheet workaround specifies annual HUD PIT; HUD PIT/CoC data is not loaded.

current_status: Partially implemented with annual and quarterly alternate proxies
observed_constructed_proxy_or_scenario: constructed survey estimate and administrative proxy
limitation: ACS annual LA County rental availability is implemented for 2010-2024 from same-vintage B25004 and B25003 inputs. The authenticated HUD/USPS quarterly all-residential address-vacancy proxy is active for 2008 Q1-2026 Q1. Neither is true monthly rental-listing inventory; ZORI and Redfin for-sale listings are not inventory substitutes.
The active monthly panel ratio uses ZHVI/ZORI. The sheet specifies FHFA/ZORI; that version needs an explicit FHFA index-to-rent construction choice and is not yet implemented.
Sales/inventory liquidity is implemented; sales/housing-stock turnover is deferred.

expected_notes_from_docx: State is clean; county is noisier
limitation: Aligned with BEA as the sheet source. State quarterly is loaded; county is annual because county quarterly personal income is limited/noisier as noted in the sheet.
